LanguageData.MM_Disruptor.label: Disruptor
LanguageData.MM_Disruptor.description:
A warframe piloted by one colonist for area attacks. It launches a homing orb that damages nearby enemies before exploding after 5 seconds. The orb only harms enemies and deals triple damage to buildings.

It cannot move or teleport while the orb is active, and needs 5 seconds to recover afterward. Occupies 2×2 cells, carries 600 kg and runs on light. When no orb is active, it can teleport with its pilot within the light network on the same map.

Can bind to a mechanitor for autonomous operation at 5 bandwidth; piloted operation uses no bandwidth.
